page: Microsoft Azure FX32mds_v2 is a high-frequency, memory-dense virtual machine within the FXmdsv2 family, hosted on Microsoft Hyper-V. The server features 32 dedicated vCPUs mapped across 16 physical cores of an Intel Xeon 8573C processor running at up to 4.2 GHz. The compute subsystem is supported by 48 KB of L1 data cache per core, 2 MB of L2 cache per core, and a substantial 260 MB shared L3 cache. It integrates hardware accelerators including AVX-512, AMX (Advanced Matrix Extensions), VAES, and SHA-NI.

The configuration provides 672.0 GB of system memory, yielding a 21.0 GB per vCPU ratio that supports extensive in-memory structures. Storage is provisioned via a bundled 1888 GB local NVMe SSD, backed by support for Azure Premium Storage. The server operates without discrete GPU accelerators and includes zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

Benchmark results demonstrate high single-core compute performance, with Geekbench single-core and text processing scores landing in the top 10 percent of evaluated systems. Large-block uncached memory bandwidth reaches 232.79 GB/sec read and 136.78 GB/sec write, both placing in the top 25 percent. Single-threaded gzip compression and PassMark CPU testing also register in the upper quartile. While small-scale LLM inference runs capably using matrix extensions, multi-threaded decompression and large 70B parameter LLM inference exhibit lower relative throughput, with 70B text generation scoring in the bottom 25 percent.

With its 4.2 GHz clock speed, massive memory pool, and high local NVMe throughput, the FX32mds_v2 balances CPU intensity with deep memory capacity. It is tailored for large in-memory databases, electronic design automation (EDA), complex financial modeling, compute-intensive simulation jobs, and batch data processing.
description: Microsoft Azure FX32mds_v2 is a compute-intensive and memory-dense virtual machine powered by a 16-core, 32-thread Intel Xeon 8573C processor clocking up to 4.2 GHz, paired with a massive 260 MB L3 cache. Configured with 672.0 GB of RAM, the instance delivers an exceptional 21.0 GB of memory per core, complemented by a bundled 1888 GB local NVMe SSD for low-latency scratch storage. It features advanced architectural instructions including AVX-512, AMX, and VAES, with no discrete GPUs present. Empirical benchmarks show strong performance in single-core Geekbench execution, text processing, PassMark encryption, and uncached memory bandwidth, while larger multi-threaded operations and heavy LLM inference reflect normal architectural scaling limits. The FX32mds_v2 is specifically designed to host large in-memory transactional databases, financial analytics engines, EDA toolchains, and high-frequency analytical computing tasks requiring fast single-thread throughput alongside massive physical memory footprints.
